title: PaymentCompleted
description: Published by payment-service on the `finpay.payment` topic when a payment reaches the terminal COMPLETED state. Partitioned by paymentId.

eventId.description: Globally unique event identifier. Consumers MUST deduplicate on this field (outbox redelivery / at-least-once semantics).

eventType.description: Fixed event type; matches the schema name and the stream-filterable discriminator.

occurredAt.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the event occurred.

version.description: Major schema version of this event. Additive changes stay at the same major; breaking changes require a new vN/ schema.

partitionKey.description: Kafka partition key; equals the business key paymentId for ordering per payment.

amount.description: Payment amount as a decimal string (no floating point).

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code of the payment.

idempotencyKey.description: Client-supplied idempotency key (Rule 6) that made this payment idempotent on creation.
